summary: Customer payment failures began at ~12:15Z because payment-service's mTLS client certificate (CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal) expired at 2026-04-02T12:15:00Z, so every outbound mTLS handshake to bank-partner-api was rejected with TLS alert 45. bank_api_error_rate jumped from 0.2% to 100% and payment_success_rate fell from ~99% to ~2.5%. The HTTP error-rate dashboard stayed green because failures are recorded as payment PENDING_RETRY rather than 5xx responses (error_rate flat at 0.22%, latency actually dropped as calls failed fast). A config change (timeout 3000->5000 at 11:20Z, 55 min before onset), a settlement-service deploy (10:30Z, unrelated service), and resource exhaustion were all ruled out. This is a credential_expiry incident on payment-service; precedent exists (HIST-106, settlement mTLS cert expiry with no renewal automation).

ranked_hypotheses.title: Expired mTLS client certificate to bank-partner-api
ranked_hypotheses.statement: payment-service's client certificate CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal expired at 2026-04-02T12:15:00Z, causing every mTLS handshake to bank-partner-api to be rejected (TLS alert 45). All bank calls failed, fund transfers were marked PENDING_RETRY, and customer payments failed. The fault originates in credential lifecycle management for payment-service's outbound cert, not in the code or the partner.

causal_chain.claim: Certificate notAfter=2026-04-02T12:15:00Z; cert-watcher warned 25 min earlier
At 12:15:27Z mTLS handshakes to bank-partner-api begin being rejected (alert 45 expired certificate)
Failures surface as PENDING_RETRY instead of HTTP 5xx, so the error_rate dashboard stays green

assumptions: The cert chain is served by payment-service itself (CN prefix 'payments-') and not by an intermediate CA that also expired
No automatic renewal ran after 12:15Z (errors continue to 13:58Z, so consistent)

ranked_hypotheses.title: Bank partner API outage (partner-side fault)
ranked_hypotheses.statement: bank-partner-api, the external vendor, returned errors for the whole window, failing fund transfers as in HIST-105. This would be a dependency_failure originating at the vendor.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: The error message explicitly names OUR client cert as expired ('our client cert CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal notAfter=2026-04-02T12:15:00Z') and the server returns TLS alert 45 (certificate_expired). A partner-side outage would not produce an expired-certificate alert about our own CN, and the onset matches our cert's notAfter to the second (12:15Z).

ranked_hypotheses.title: bank.api.timeout_ms config change (3000->5000) caused the failures
ranked_hypotheses.statement: Raising the bank API timeout at 11:20Z induced slow/failed bank calls.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: The change landed at 11:20Z but onset is 12:15Z (55 min later, matching cert expiry exactly, not the change). Failures are TLS handshake rejections, unrelated to timeouts, and latency actually fell rather than rose.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Resource exhaustion in payment-service
ranked_hypotheses.statement: CPU/memory/connection pool exhaustion caused the payment failures.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: cpu_pct flat ~30%, restarts 0, db_pool_in_use flat ~8. No resource pressure at all.

ranked_hypotheses.title: settlement-service deploy dep-5510 caused it
ranked_hypotheses.statement: The v1.9.0 settlement-service deploy at 10:30Z introduced the fault.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: Deploy completed cleanly at 10:30Z, 1h45m before onset, and settlement-service logs show only GC warnings. The failing component is payment-service's outbound cert to bank-partner-api.

facts.statement: payment-service HTTP error_rate was flat at ~0.22% during the outage (dashboard green).
The client cert CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal had notAfter=2026-04-02T12:15:00Z, warned 25 min in advance by cert-watcher.
payment-service logged mTLS handshake rejections and 'tls: expired certificate (alert 45)' naming its own client cert.
Latency fell and CPU/restarts/DB pool were flat, ruling out resource exhaustion and saturation.
No payment-service deployment occurred; only an unrelated settlement-service deploy and a bank.api.timeout_ms config change 55 min before onset.
api-gateway metrics were entirely flat, so the symptom was invisible at the edge.

assumptions: The cert chain served by payment-service is the only expired element (no expired intermediate CA).
No automatic cert rotation succeeded after 12:15Z, consistent with errors persisting to 13:58Z.
PENDING_RETRY payments are recoverable via replay once mTLS works.

timeline.event: settlement-service dep-5510 v1.9.0 deployed and rolled out cleanly (unrelated).
cfg-2502 bank.api.timeout_ms raised 3000->5000 on payment-service (ruled out).
cert-watcher warns client cert expires at 12:15:00Z.
First mTLS handshake rejection; payments marked PENDING_RETRY.
Errors still ongoing at latest data.

recommended_actions.action: Immediately issue/renew the payment-service mTLS client certificate for bank-partner-api and roll it out, then verify mTLS handshakes succeed and payment_success_rate recovers.
recommended_actions.rationale: The expired cert is the confirmed cause; failures continue at latest data.

recommended_actions.action: Replay/requeue the PENDING_RETRY payments accumulated since 12:15Z once the cert is restored.
recommended_actions.rationale: Fund transfers were deferred, not lost; customers need settlement.

recommended_actions.action: Fix monitoring: alert on bank_api_error_rate and payment_success_rate (not just HTTP error_rate), since HTTP 5xx stayed green while payments failed.
recommended_actions.rationale: The dashboard masked a total payment outage for >1.5h.

recommended_actions.action: Add certificate-expiry alerting and automated renewal for all mTLS client certs (recurrence of HIST-106).
recommended_actions.rationale: cert-watcher warned but no automated action taken; same class of incident happened before.

recommended_actions.action: Review whether payment failures should surface as elevated error rate instead of silently becoming PENDING_RETRY.
recommended_actions.rationale: Silent conversion to retry hid the impact from error-rate SLOs.

data_gaps: payment-service memory_pct query failed (backend 503) - memory exhaustion not directly confirmed, though CPU/restarts were flat.
bank-partner-api has no telemetry (has_telemetry=false), so we cannot directly confirm the partner was healthy; the TLS alert content is the only signal from that side.
No cert inventory/renewal-automation data available to confirm why the cert was not rotated before expiry.

findings.statement: payment-service HTTP 5xx error_rate stayed flat at ~0.22% across 11:00-13:59Z, matching the report that the error-rate dashboard is green.
payment-service bank_api_error_rate was ~0.2% until 12:00Z, then rose to 75% at 12:12Z and 100% from 12:24Z onward.
payment-service payment_success_rate collapsed from ~99% to 26.8% at 12:12Z and ~2.5% from 12:24Z onward.
cert-watcher logged at 11:50:26Z that client certificate CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal expires in 25 minutes at notAfter=2026-04-02T12:15:00Z.

refs.quote: cert-watcher: client certificate CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal expires in 25 minutes (notAfter=2026-04-02T12:15:00Z)

findings.statement: From 12:15:27Z payment-service logged 140 'marked PENDING_RETRY: mTLS handshake with bank-partner-api rejected' errors, first-seen 12:15:27Z.

refs.quote: payment <n> marked PENDING_RETRY: mTLS handshake with bank-partner-api rejected

findings.statement: payment-service logged 171 'bank-partner-api call failed: remote error: tls: expired certificate (alert 45); our client cert CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal notAfter=2026-04-02T12:15:00Z' errors, first-seen 12:16:44Z.

refs.quote: remote error: tls: expired certificate (alert 45); our client cert CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal notAfter=2026-04-02T12:15:00Z

findings.statement: payment-service latency_p99_ms actually DROPPED from ~320ms to ~140ms at 12:12Z (failing fast on TLS rejection), not increased.
payment-service request_rate stayed flat at ~100 req/s through the whole window; no traffic surge.
api-gateway error_rate (~0.21%) and latency_p99_ms (~210ms) were completely flat through the incident, so the symptom is not visible at the edge.
payment-service cpu_pct was flat at ~30% and restarts were 0 across the window; db_pool_in_use was flat at ~8 connections.
No payment-service code deployment occurred; the only deploy in the window was settlement-service dep-5510 v1.9.0 at 10:30Z, which completed rollout with all pods ready.

refs.quote: deployment dep-5510 (v1.9.0) rollout complete, all pods ready

findings.statement: The only config change was cfg-2502 on payment-service: bank.api.timeout_ms raised 3000->5000 at 11:20Z, ~55 min before onset.
settlement-service showed only GC-pause warnings (273ms/391ms) and normal INFO heartbeats; no failures aligned with the 12:15Z onset.
bank-partner-api is an external dependency with has_telemetry=false, so no direct vendor-side telemetry is available.

The failure mode is distinct from a partner-side outage: the log identifies OUR client cert (CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal) as the expired element, with the server responding 'alert 45' (certificate_expired).

refs.quote: Bank partner API returned 5xx for 40 minutes (their incident)

findings.statement: payment 5xx counter is green because payment-service absorbs bank failures as PENDING_RETRY rather than returning HTTP errors, so the dashboard metric never fires.
